data.one_liner: Flutter widget that renders a Row and automatically injects separators between children.
data.what_it_does: SeparatedRow renders a Row widget while dynamically injecting separators between its children using a builder function. It also supports optional outer separators before the first and after the last element.
use_when: You need to display a Row with consistent spacing or dividers between every child.
You want to avoid manually repeating divider widgets between list items in a horizontal layout.
avoid_when: You are building a vertical list or column instead of a horizontal row.
You do not need dynamic separators between items.
strengths: Simplifies horizontal layouts by automating separator insertion.
Supports custom separator builders and outer separator modes.
weaknesses: Limited to row layouts, though a companion package exists for columns.
data.minimal_example:
SeparatedRow(
  children: [
    Text("Item 1"),
    Text("Item 2"),
  ],
  separatorBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index) => const VerticalDivider(),
)
